note: Reviewed outcome targets for Migration 041. Every label is defined on a fixed horizon counted in seasons from the signing year and exists only once the horizon has fully elapsed. Support thresholds apply per reference population; populations are never pooled.

targets.label: MLB debut by signing year + 7 seasons
targets.label_rule: TRUE when the audited MLB debut season is at most signing year + 7; FALSE when the audited outcome is no MLB debut, or a debut after the horizon; NULL when unaudited.

targets.label: Positive bWAR by signing year + 10 seasons
targets.label_rule: TRUE when the Baseball-Reference team-season bWAR of seasons up to signing year + 10 sums above 0; FALSE for an audited no-MLB outcome, a debut after the horizon, or a sum at or below 0; NULL when unaudited or a reacher has no loaded season.

targets.label: 2+ bWAR by signing year + 10 seasons
targets.label_rule: TRUE when the team-season bWAR of seasons up to signing year + 10 sums to 2 or more; otherwise as POSITIVE_BWAR_WITHIN_10_SEASONS.

targets.label: Dodgers MLB bWAR above 0 by signing year + 10 seasons
targets.label_rule: Dodgers signings only: TRUE when the team-season bWAR with the Dodgers franchise in seasons up to signing year + 10 sums above 0; FALSE for no MLB, a debut after the horizon, or no positive Dodgers bWAR; NULL when unaudited.
